description: This source file implements validation functions for CU-CP unit configurations, including event trigger parameters, mobility, security, PDCP, RLC, QoS, AMF, and overall CU-CP configurations within a 5G network context.

methods.name: validate_event_trigger_params
methods.description: Validates event-triggered measurement parameters for report configurations, ensuring required fields and ranges are set based on event type.

methods.name: validate_mobility_appconfig
methods.description: Validates mobility configuration, including report configs and cell parameters, ensuring uniqueness and consistency.

methods.name: validate_security_appconfig
methods.description: Validates security configuration, including ciphering and integrity algorithms preferences.

methods.name: validate_pdcp_appconfig
methods.description: Validates PDCP configuration parameters such as SN length, status report requirement, and t-Reordering.

methods.name: validate_rlc_um_appconfig
methods.description: Validates RLC UM mode configuration, including SN size, queue size, and t-Reassembly.

methods.name: validate_rlc_am_appconfig
methods.description: Validates RLC AM mode configuration, including SN size, t-PollRetransmit, max_retx_thresh, poll_pdu, poll_byte, and max_sn_per_status.

methods.name: validate_rlc_appconfig
methods.description: Validates RLC configuration, checking mode and specific mode configurations.

methods.name: validate_qos_appconfig
methods.description: Validates QoS configuration for each QoS profile, including PDCP and RLC settings.

methods.name: validate_amf_appconfig
methods.description: Validates AMF configuration, including IP addresses, binding, supported tracking areas, and PLMN/TAC uniqueness.

methods.name: validate_cu_cp_appconfig
methods.description: Validates overall CU-CP configuration, including AMF, mobility, security, and QoS settings.

methods.name: validate_cu_cp_unit_config
methods.description: Public function that validates the entire CU-CP unit configuration by invoking specific validation routines.
